compliance.settlement_party: Fair Share Housing Center; NJBA mediation

notes: Oradell is a nearly fully developed community. DCA assigned 186-unit prospective need; borough analysis produced 174; NJBA mediation settled at 180 (May 13, 2025). VLA reduces RDP to 3 (from 445-447 Kinderkamack Rd site), leaving unmet need of 177. Round 4 plan: (1) rezone 445-447 Kinderkamack Rd at 22 du/ac for 15 total/3 affordable units; (2) Habitat for Humanity Reis Ave (Block 107, Lot 29) satisfying 25%-of-RDP one-unit requirement; (3) expand CBD overlay zone northward on Kinderkamack Road (B-1 zone extension + B-3 rezoned to B-1) to address unmet need. 505 Kinderkamack Rd (3 affordable age-restricted units) and 387-393 Kinderkamack Rd (1 affordable rental) are prior-round credits under existing mandatory set-aside/CBD overlay. 420 Kinderkamack Rd application is pending Planning Board under prior-round CBD overlay. Block 223, Lot 5 (Genther Ave/BCUW) is a prior-round unmet need credit. Candidate snapshot had 6 sites but HEFSP shows only 3 Round 4-specific sites (Kinderkamack 445-447 rezone, Reis Ave Habitat, CBD overlay extension).

sources.title: Housing Element and Fair Share Plan, Borough of Oradell, Prepared June 13, 2025, Adopted June 24, 2025
sources.excerpt: Oradell's Round 4 prospective need obligation is 180 units...the Borough is entitled to a Vacant Land Adjustment (VLA) for Round 4...RDP of three for this site [445-447 Kinderkamack Rd], resulting in an unmet of 177.

sites.quote: 445-447 Kinderkamack Road. The Borough proposes to rezone this property at a density of 22 units per acre, resulting in the potential for a development of 15 units, of which 3 units (20%) are affordable.
sites.notes: Round 4 RDP site. 0.71-acre parcel. Developer proposed 40 units/8 affordable at 57 du/ac; borough rejected as out of character. Rezoning at 22 du/ac per court-approved CBD zone standard. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP text; block/lot from candidate snapshot (Block 1102, Lot 1 for 420 Kinderkamack is different site; 445-447 block/lot not confirmed). Bonus credit of 0.75 for prior nonresidential use.

sites.site_name: Habitat for Humanity - Reis Avenue (Block 107, Lot 29)
sites.address: Corner of Kinderkamack Road and Reis Avenue, Oradell, NJ
sites.developer: Habitat for Humanity of Bergen County
sites.quote: Habitat for Humanity, Reis Avenue.  This property, located at the corner of Kinderkamack Road and Reis Avenue, is also known as Block 107, Lot 29.  The Borough donated this property to Habitat to provide an opportunity for affordable housing. Habitat for Humanity presently is constructing one dwelling unit containing three bedrooms on the subject property.
sites.notes: Counts as the '25% of adjusted prospective need' (1 unit) required by FHA 2. Borough donated the property to Habitat. Three-bedroom for-sale affordable unit.

sites.site_name: CBD Overlay Zone Extension (Kinderkamack Road Corridor - Unmet Need)
sites.address: Kinderkamack Road corridor (Orchard St to Soldier Hill Rd), Oradell, NJ
sites.quote: 1. Expand the B-1 zone/CBD overlay zone northward on the western side of Kinderkamack Road from Orchard Street to Soldier Hill Road. 2. Rezone the B-3 zone to the B-1 zone/CBD overlay zone...The above revisions add an additional approximately 14 acres to the overlay zone to address unmet need.
sites.notes: Addresses Round 4 unmet need (177 units). Extends the existing CBD overlay that produced prior round credits. Specific block/lots of expanded area not individually listed in HEFSP text.

sites.site_name: Bergen County United Way - Genther Ave (Block 223, Lot 5) [Prior Round Credit]
sites.developer: Bergen County United Way / Madeline Corp NFP
sites.quote: agreement with Bergen County United Way for the property known as Block 223, Lot 5 located on Genther Ave. The Borough donated Lot 5 to Bergen County United Way (BCUW) so that the lot could be developed with special needs and supportive housing...approval was granted for the following: A four-bedroom group home to be constructed on the first floor. A one-bedroom and a two-bedroom supportive housing (independent living) apartment on the second floor.
sites.notes: Prior-round (Rounds 1-3 unmet need) credit site, not a Round 4 prospective need site. Borough donated to BCUW. ZBA approved May 19, 2025 (Cal. No. 874-24). 4 total units: 1 four-bedroom group home + 1 one-bedroom + 1 two-bedroom supportive housing.

sites.site_name: 505 Kinderkamack Road (Age-Restricted Mandatory Set-Aside) [Prior Round Credit]
sites.quote: 505 Kinderkamack Road: three (3) affordable age restricted units that are constructed. These units resulted from the mandatory set-aside ordinance.
sites.notes: Prior-round credit under mandatory set-aside ordinance. Block/lot not stated in HEFSP. Candidate snapshot referenced 20 total units / 3 affordable, age-restricted rental at this address (ZBA CAL #891-25 amendment). HEFSP confirms 3 affordable age-restricted units constructed.

sites.site_name: 387-393 Kinderkamack Road (CBD Overlay - Family Rental) [Prior Round Credit]
sites.quote: 387-393 Kinderkamack Road: one (1) family affordable rental unit, which resulted from the CBD Overlay Zone.
sites.notes: Prior-round credit under CBD overlay zone mechanism. Block/lot not stated.
